note: The archived server-rendered preview is accompanied by the compiled Cloud Castle page component and captured style/assets. The isolated adapter implements its source opening and parallax behavior without copying the Chorlove Next.js site runtime, external music, owner contact values, sample wishes, or hard-coded invitation data.

previewBrowserCapture.source: ChatGPT in-app browser rendering of the app preview with the canonical fixture

catalogArtwork.source: Clean capture of the packaged Cloud Castle snapshot renderer, showing the post-envelope opening hero at 720x1280; capture harness removed before delivery
catalogArtwork.provenanceLimit: The clean image verifies the captured opening artwork and crop. The archived compiled page component is recorded separately and provides the original interaction and animation source used by the adapter.

pageModule.captureStatus: present in the archived Chorlove chunk tree

opening.particleMotion: deterministic source positions/sizes/sways/durations/delays; falling uses per-particle delay; sway uses a half-duration keyframe sequence with alternate/reverse cycles; rotation and opacity start without the fall delay

profiles.heroGreeting: opacity 0/y 24 to opacity 1/y 0; threshold .5; 750ms with 80ms delay easeOut
profiles.heroNames: opacity 0/y 38/scale .92 to opacity 1/y 0/scale 1; threshold .35; 900ms with 140ms delay easeOut
profiles.scheduleRows: opacity 0/scale .86/y 10 to opacity 1/scale 1/y 0; threshold .2; 450ms with 90ms per row cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)
profiles.galleryItems: opacity 0/scale .86/y 10 to opacity 1/scale 1/y 0; threshold .2; 450ms with source delays .06/.14/.22/.30/.38 seconds
profiles.contactLinks: opacity 0/y 18/scale .96 to opacity 1/y 0/scale 1; threshold .3; 550ms with 120ms initial delay and 100ms per link
profiles.guestbook: opacity 0/scale .88/y 10 to opacity 1/scale 1/y 0; threshold .5; 480ms; heading/form/list stagger follows source .08/.14s spacing

sourceBehavior.reducedMotion: The adapter suppresses source ambient/entrance motion and opens immediately.

giftDisclosure.copy: navigator clipboard writeText with spaces removed; copied label resets after 2500ms
giftDisclosure.enterExit: opacity 0/1 and scale .92 to 1 with y 20 to 0
giftDisclosure.dismiss: close button, backdrop click, or Escape

sourceBehavior.rsvpPartySize: The captured Cloud Castle RSVP has no party-size control; platform API receives 1 for yes and 0 for no.
